description: This file defines an internal sealed class 'InvokableMethodDescription' that models metadata and attributes of an invokable method within the Orleans code generation framework. It includes properties for method identifiers, attributes, timeout configurations, type parameters, and related metadata used during source code analysis and generation.

classes.name: InvokableMethodDescription
classes.description: Represents a detailed description and metadata for an invokable method within the Orleans code generation system, including attributes, type parameters, and timeout settings.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate 'InvokableMethodDescription' with a method ID and containing type.
